title: Ikala character animationSet
description: The clips a body plan plays for each action, like idle, move or attack.melee.1. Sets for the same plan merge, the first in ID order winning where two define an action.

clips.description: Its clips: one, several picked from at random by weight, or several with speeds, blended by how fast the character moves.

mask.description: The plan's bone group it plays on, like "upperBody", so the legs keep walking. Left out, it plays on the whole body.

fade.description: How long it takes to blend in, in seconds.

AnimationSet.description: The clips a body plan plays for each action, like idle, move or attack.melee.1. Sets for the same plan merge, the first in ID order winning where two define an action.

variants.description: Actions that differ for a variant, by variant name, then action.

extends.description: The ID of a definition of the same kind to start from. Fields written here replace the parent's, and objects merge field by field.

clip.description: The clip, as its file and its name in that file, like "rpg_human/rpg_male.glb#run", relative to its namespace's content folder.

speed.description: How fast it moves the character, in meters per second, for actions blended by speed.

rate.description: How fast it plays, times its authored speed.

loop.description: Whether it repeats. Left out, the file decides.

weight.description: How likely it is picked among the action's clips.

events.description: Timed events it fires, like footsteps and hits.

Event.description: Something that happens at a moment of a clip.

at.description: When, in seconds from the clip's start.

event.description: What, like "foot.L.down", "hit", or "fx:" and an effect ID to burst it.

bone.description: The bone an fx: event bursts its effect at, like "foot.L". Left out, the root.
